sources.title: Become an Aviation Mechanic
sources.supportedFact: Uncertificated work has supervised or organizationally authorized pathways; practical-experience and approved-school routes exist.
sources.limits: Supports this selected supervised beginner pathway, not a universal entry title or automatic certification.

sources.title: 14 CFR 43.3(d)
sources.supportedFact: A certificate holder observes as necessary and is readily available in person; excluded required inspections are not delegated here.
sources.limits: Sora conducts the inspection; the learner assists by observing and drafting, never performs a required inspection independently.

sources.title: 14 CFR 43.13(a)
sources.supportedFact: Maintenance uses current manufacturer instructions or other methods acceptable to the Administrator.
sources.limits: General methods source; air carrier program and manual govern real airline assignments. The game teaches only selecting current applicable airline instructions, not any procedure.

sources.title: AC 20-62E Change 1: Eligibility, Quality, and Identification of Aeronautical Replacement Parts
sources.supportedFact: Part eligibility, identification and traceability require supporting information.
sources.limits: Advisory guidance; flagging a mismatch is not proving counterfeiting or determining installation eligibility.

sources.title: FAA Foreign Object Debris Program
sources.supportedFact: Foreign object debris is material in an inappropriate location that can damage aircraft or injure personnel.
sources.limits: Airport guidance supports hazard recognition; it is not an aircraft maintenance procedure.

sources.title: AC 120-72A: Maintenance Human Factors Training
sources.supportedFact: Maintenance human factors training addresses communication, teamwork and following procedures.
sources.limits: Advisory training framework, not a mandatory universal handoff form or authorization to sign work.

sources.title: 14 CFR 43.9: Maintenance records
sources.supportedFact: Records describe work performed and identify the approving person as applicable.
sources.limits: Context only: air carriers have their own applicable record systems. This player writes an internal draft, not a regulatory approval entry.

sources.title: FAASTeam ALC-180: Aircraft Maintenance Documentation for AMTs (2012 core course), review section on shift/task turnover
sources.supportedFact: Effective shift/task turnover requires communication and transfer of information about unfinished work; inadequate written and verbal communication can contribute to maintenance errors.
sources.limits: Training guidance supports the handoff concept. Gannet's open-check/status/reviewer wording is a fictional local practice, not a mandated universal form.

sources.title: Delta Technical Operations Careers
sources.supportedFact: Aircraft Support Mechanic is an entry role learning under experienced maintenance technicians and assisting with technical and nontechnical work.
sources.limits: One real employer pathway supports the chosen stage; fictional Gannet is not Delta and no hiring, endorsement or certification promise is made.

sources.title: Aircraft and Avionics Equipment Mechanics and Technicians
sources.supportedFact: Mechanics work with maintenance instructions and records; work occurs in hangars and on airfields, with several training routes.
sources.limits: General occupational duties do not grant a first-week learner independent authority.

sources.title: 14 CFR 121.369: Manual requirements
sources.supportedFact: Air carrier maintenance manuals describe maintenance procedures and related responsibilities.
sources.limits: The game does not supply an airline manual or claim a universal procedural checklist.

sources.title: FAA AC 120-124: Continuous Airworthiness Maintenance Program Training Program
sources.supportedFact: FAA guidance describes maintenance training for air carrier programs.
sources.limits: Supports employer-specific preparation, not a playable maintenance qualification.

roleContract.pathway: Selected US airline support-mechanic entry route, with mentoring and assigned support tasks. Not a universal title or hiring requirement.
roleContract.prerequisites: Workplace induction and assigned safe observation position. Support work only; no aircraft-specific technical competence assumed. Employer program and authorization govern real assignments.
roleContract.context: First supervised week at fictional Gannet Regional Airlines; observation, part-label comparison and a draft finding brief for a regional passenger aircraft.
roleContract.supervisor: Sora, appropriately rated certificated mechanic, available in person and personally observing as needed.
roleContract.allowed: Read assigned references, observe alongside Sora, draft factual findings, compare identifiers, flag concerns, communicate open status.
roleContract.escalation: Pause assigned work and consult Sora; Elena coordinates supervisor review.
roleContract.outsideRole: Independent required inspection, diagnosis, repair choice, part eligibility approval, operating aircraft, regulatory sign-off, return-to-service approval.

fictionalData: all people, setting, deadlines, observations, kit codes K-42 and K-24, and workplace rules
The marked hold area and finding brief are fictional local training practices.
